title: "baseballCleaning"
format: html

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

pitchers <- read.csv("phoebechar/baseball/pitchersLarge.csv")

pitchers <- pitchers |> select(player_name, pitch_type, type, release_speed, events, description, des, balls, strikes, outs_when_up)

write_csv(pitchers, "phoebechar/baseball/pitchers.csv")
```
